name: Mukilteo
seo_title: 3 Christmas Events for Kids in Mukilteo, WA 2026
seo_desc: 3 Christmas events for kids in Mukilteo, WA, 2 free: Mukilteo Holiday Lights and Merry Mukilteo Tree Lighting and Gingerbread Houses and more.
lede: Mukilteo keeps Christmas close to its Old Town waterfront: the city's Merry Mukilteo celebration fills the Rosehill Community Center with gingerbread houses and ends with a tree lighting, and Santa comes back for a pancake brunch.
celebrates: The season centers on Merry Mukilteo at the Rosehill Community Center on Lincoln Avenue in Old Town. The city invites families to build gingerbread houses in the afternoon, then gathers everyone for its signature tree lighting, with musical performances, cookie decorating and outdoor fire pits along the way. The next day the city runs a wreath making session, and a few weeks later it hosts Brunch with Santa at Rosehill, a free pancake brunch with holiday music, ornament decorating, photos alongside Santa and a set from the Olympic View Middle School Jazz Band. The Mukilteo Community Orchestra also plays a holiday concert at Rosehill in December.
lastyear: In 2025 Merry Mukilteo took place on Saturday, December 6, from 3 to 6 pm at the Rosehill Community Center, and the city called it free and open to all. The schedule had gingerbread house making at 2 and 3 pm, Santa photos until 5 pm, a Lions Club children's book giveaway, a Cat Coalition kitten corner, dance routines from The Little Gym and Allegro, the Olympic View Middle School Band, the North Seattle Chinese Dance Group and The MidKnights from Kamiak, with the tree lit at 5:45 pm on the lower plaza.
facts: Mukilteo is one of the oldest settlements in Snohomish County. The Point Elliott Treaty was signed there in 1855, and in 1931 the Daughters of the American Revolution placed a monument to it in front of Rose Hill School at Third Street and Lincoln Avenue, the same corner where families now gather at Rosehill for the tree lighting. Mukilteo served as the first county seat in 1861 until a vote moved it to Snohomish. The Mukilteo lighthouse began operating in 1906, and the city incorporated in 1947.
trains: Trains run right along the Mukilteo shoreline. The Great Northern laid its rails along the coast in the 1890s, mostly for freight, and later a steep grade was built through Japanese Gulch to the Boeing plant. Today Mukilteo Station at 920 First Street, beside the ferry terminal, is a stop on the Sounder N Line between Everett, Edmonds and Seattle, which runs on weekday peak hours. Everett Station, one stop north, adds Amtrak Cascades and the Empire Builder. For a holiday train ride, the Northwest Railway Museum runs its North Pole Limited Santa Train from North Bend.

kidfact: Mukilteo was once the boss of the whole county. In 1861 it was the first county seat of Snohomish County, until a vote moved the job to the town of Snohomish.
faq: When is the Mukilteo tree lighting?

The City of Mukilteo lights its tree at the end of Merry Mukilteo, its holiday celebration at the Rosehill Community Center on the first weekend of December. Families build gingerbread houses in the afternoon and gather for the lighting in the early evening. In 2025 the event ran from 3 to 6 pm and the tree was lit at 5:45 pm.

Yes. In 2025 the city said Merry Mukilteo was free and open to all, and the Discover Mukilteo events calendar lists this year's tree lighting and gingerbread houses as free. Past years have also included Santa photos, a children's book giveaway from the Lions Club, dance groups and school bands inside the community center.
Where is Brunch with Santa in Mukilteo?

At the Rosehill Community Center, 304 Lincoln Avenue, in Old Town Mukilteo. The City of Mukilteo Recreation team runs it as a free event for all ages, with registration on the city's recreation site. Staff serve a holiday pancake brunch, kids decorate ornaments, a middle school jazz band plays and families take photos alongside Santa.
Can we take the train to Mukilteo?

Yes, on weekdays. Mukilteo Station, at 920 First Street next to the ferry terminal, is a stop on the Sounder N Line between Seattle, Edmonds and Everett, which runs during weekday peak hours. On weekends the closest passenger trains are Amtrak Cascades at Edmonds or Everett. The Rosehill Community Center is a short uphill walk from the waterfront.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Mukilteo for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Mukilteo Holiday Lights) through December 31, with Mukilteo Holiday Lights (from November 27), Merry Mukilteo Tree Lighting and Gingerbread Houses (December 5) and Brunch with Santa at Rosehill Community Center (December 20) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Mukilteo families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.
